# ============================================================
# 2. PRODUCTIVITY CLASSIFICATION
# ============================================================

classify_productivity <- function(planned, actual, distraction, focus) {
  
  if (is.na(planned) || planned == 0) return("Moderate")
  completion <- actual / planned
  
  if (completion >= 0.80 && distraction <= 1.5 && focus >= 4) {
    return("High")
  } else if (completion < 0.50 || distraction > 3 || focus <= 2) {
    return("Low")
  } else {
    return("Moderate")
  }
}


# ============================================================
# 3. DEFAULT TRANSITION MATRIX
# ============================================================

default_matrix <- function() {
  
  P <- matrix(
    c(
      0.65, 0.30, 0.05,
      0.30, 0.50, 0.20,
      0.15, 0.35, 0.50
    ),
    nrow = 3,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
  
  rownames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  colnames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  
  return(P)
}


# ============================================================
# 4. ESTIMATE TRANSITION MATRIX FROM HISTORY
# ============================================================

estimate_matrix <- function(states) {
  
  P <- matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
  rownames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  colnames(P) <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
  
  if (length(states) < 2 || all(is.na(states))) {
    return(default_matrix())
  }
  
  for (i in 1:(length(states) - 1)) {
    from <- match(states[i], rownames(P))
    to   <- match(states[i + 1], colnames(P))
    
    if (!is.na(from) && !is.na(to)) {
      P[from, to] <- P[from, to] + 1
    }
  }
  
  for (i in 1:3) {
    row_total <- sum(P[i, ])
    
    if (row_total > 0) {
      P[i, ] <- P[i, ] / row_total
    } else {
      P[i, ] <- default_matrix()[i, ]
    }
  }
  
  return(P)
}


# ============================================================
# 5. STATIONARY DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================

stationary_distribution <- function(P) {
  
  pi_vec <- c(1/3, 1/3, 1/3)
  
  for (i in 1:10000) {
    new_pi <- as.numeric(pi_vec %*% P)
    
    if (max(abs(new_pi - pi_vec)) < 0.0000001) {
      return(new_pi)
    }
    
    pi_vec <- new_pi
  }
  
  return(pi_vec)
}

# ============================================================
# 9. SERVER
# ============================================================

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  data_store <- reactiveVal(study_data)
  
  observe({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      updateSelectInput(session, "delete_date", choices = character(0))
    } else {
      d <- d[order(d$Date, decreasing = TRUE), ]
      choices <- setNames(as.character(d$Date), format(d$Date, "%d %b %Y (%a)"))
      updateSelectInput(session, "delete_date", choices = choices)
    }
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$exam, {
    updateSelectInput(session, "topic", choices = topics_by_exam[[input$exam]])
  })
  
  current_state <- reactive({
    classify_productivity(input$planned, input$actual, input$distraction, input$focus)
  })
  
  output$live_state <- renderUI({
    state <- current_state()
    if (state == "High") {
      div(class = "success-box", h2("\U0001F7E2 HIGH PRODUCTIVITY"), p("Excellent study day!"))
    } else if (state == "Moderate") {
      div(class = "warning-box", h2("\U0001F7E1 MODERATE PRODUCTIVITY"), p("You made reasonable progress."))
    } else {
      div(class = "danger-box", h2("\U0001F534 LOW PRODUCTIVITY"), p("Use today's data to identify what disrupted your routine."))
    }
  })
  
  output$daily_summary <- renderTable({
    completion <- if (input$planned > 0) input$actual / input$planned * 100 else 0
    accuracy <- if (!is.na(input$problems_attempted) && input$problems_attempted > 0) {
      round(input$problems_correct / input$problems_attempted * 100, 1)
    } else { NA }
    
    data.frame(
      Measure = c("Exam", "Topic", "Planned Study", "Actual Study", "Completion",
                  "Study Sessions", "Breaks", "Problems Attempted", "Problems Correct",
                  "Accuracy", "Mock Score", "Distraction", "Sleep", "Focus", "Productivity"),
      Value = c(input$exam, input$topic, paste0(input$planned, " hours"), paste0(input$actual, " hours"),
                paste0(round(completion, 1), "%"), input$sessions, input$breaks,
                input$problems_attempted, input$problems_correct,
                ifelse(is.na(accuracy), "-", paste0(accuracy, "%")),
                ifelse(is.na(input$mock_score), "-", paste0(input$mock_score, "%")),
                paste0(input$distraction, " hours"), paste0(input$sleep, " hours"),
                paste0(input$focus, "/5"), current_state())
    )
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$save, {
    new_row <- data.frame(
      Date               = as.Date(input$date),
      Exam               = input$exam,
      Topic              = input$topic,
      Planned_Hours      = input$planned,
      Study_Hours        = input$actual,
      Sessions           = input$sessions,
      Breaks             = input$breaks,
      Distraction_Hours  = input$distraction,
      Sleep_Hours        = input$sleep,
      Focus              = input$focus,
      Problems_Attempted = input$problems_attempted,
      Problems_Correct   = input$problems_correct,
      Mock_Score         = input$mock_score,
      State              = current_state(),
      stringsAsFactors   = FALSE
    )
    
    old_data <- data_store()
    old_data <- old_data[old_data$Date != new_row$Date, ]
    new_data <- rbind(old_data, new_row)
    new_data <- new_data[order(new_data$Date), ]
    data_store(new_data)
    
    showNotification(paste("Saved:", current_state(), "productivity -", input$exam), type = "message")
  })
  
  output$history <- renderTable({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
    d <- d[order(d$Date, decreasing = TRUE), ]
    accuracy <- ifelse(!is.na(d$Problems_Attempted) & d$Problems_Attempted > 0,
                       paste0(round(d$Problems_Correct / d$Problems_Attempted * 100, 1), "%"), "-")
    
    data.frame(
      Date        = format(as.Date(d$Date), "%d %b %Y"),
      Exam        = d$Exam,
      Topic       = d$Topic,
      Planned     = paste0(d$Planned_Hours, " h"),
      Studied     = paste0(d$Study_Hours, " h"),
      Problems    = paste0(d$Problems_Correct, "/", d$Problems_Attempted),
      Accuracy    = accuracy,
      Mock        = ifelse(is.na(d$Mock_Score), "-", paste0(d$Mock_Score, "%")),
      Distraction = paste0(d$Distraction_Hours, " h"),
      Sleep       = paste0(d$Sleep_Hours, " h"),
      Focus       = paste0(d$Focus, "/5"),
      State       = d$State
    )
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)
  
  observeEvent(input$delete_selected, {
    req(input$delete_date)
    d <- data_store()
    target <- as.Date(input$delete_date)
    d <- d[as.Date(d$Date) != target, ]
    data_store(d)
    showNotification(paste("Deleted record for", format(target, "%d %b %Y")), type = "warning")
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$clear_all, {
    if (isTRUE(input$confirm_clear_all)) {
      data_store(study_data)
      updateCheckboxInput(session, "confirm_clear_all", value = FALSE)
      showNotification("All history cleared.", type = "warning")
    } else {
      showNotification("Check the confirmation box first if you really want to erase everything.", type = "error")
    }
  })
  
  P <- reactive({ estimate_matrix(data_store()$State) })
  
  output$matrix <- renderTable({ round(P(), 3) }, rownames = TRUE)
  
  output$matrix_warning <- renderUI({
    n <- nrow(data_store())
    if (n < 15) {
      div(style = "color:#d97706; font-weight:bold; margin-top:15px;",
          paste("\U000026A0 You currently have", n, "days. Logged data will improve matrix accuracy over time."))
    } else {
      div(style = "color:#16a34a; font-weight:bold; margin-top:15px;",
          paste("\U00002713 Matrix based on", n, "days of history."))
    }
  })
  
  output$latest_state <- renderText({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return("No logs yet")
    tail(d$State, 1)
  })
  
  output$latest_hours <- renderText({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return("0 h")
    paste0(tail(d$Study_Hours, 1), " h")
  })
  
  tomorrow_probabilities <- reactive({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(c(High = 0.333, Moderate = 0.333, Low = 0.333))
    latest <- tail(d$State, 1)
    row <- match(latest, c("High", "Moderate", "Low"))
    P()[row, ]
  })
  
  output$tomorrow_state <- renderText({
    states <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
    states[which.max(tomorrow_probabilities())]
  })
  
  output$high_chance <- renderText({
    paste0(round(tomorrow_probabilities()[1] * 100, 1), "%")
  })
  
  output$productivity_plot <- renderPlot({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "No study data logged yet."); return()
    }
    y <- match(d$State, c("Low", "Moderate", "High"))
    plot(d$Date, y, type = "o", pch = 19, lwd = 2, ylim = c(1, 3), yaxt = "n", xlab = "Date", ylab = "Productivity")
    axis(2, at = 1:3, labels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"))
    grid()
  })
  
  output$hours_plot <- renderPlot({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "No study data logged yet."); return()
    }
    plot(d$Date, d$Planned_Hours, type = "l", lwd = 2, xlab = "Date", ylab = "Hours",
         ylim = range(c(d$Planned_Hours, d$Study_Hours)))
    lines(d$Date, d$Study_Hours, lwd = 3)
    legend("topleft", legend = c("Planned", "Actual"), lwd = c(2, 3), bty = "n")
    grid()
  })
  
  output$matrix_plot <- renderPlot({
    barplot(t(P()), beside = TRUE, names.arg = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"),
            ylim = c(0, 1), ylab = "Probability", xlab = "Today's State",
            legend.text = c("High Tomorrow", "Moderate Tomorrow", "Low Tomorrow"),
            args.legend = list(x = "topright", bty = "n"))
    grid(nx = NA, ny = NULL)
  })
  
  forecast <- reactive({
    d <- data_store()
    current <- if (nrow(d) == 0) 2 else match(tail(d$State, 1), c("High", "Moderate", "Low"))
    result <- matrix(0, nrow = 15, ncol = 3)
    result[1, current] <- 1
    
    for (i in 2:15) {
      result[i, ] <- result[i - 1, ] %*% P()
    }
    
    data.frame(Day = 0:14, High = result[, 1], Moderate = result[, 2], Low = result[, 3])
  })
  
  output$forecast_message <- renderUI({
    probs <- tomorrow_probabilities()
    states <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
    best <- which.max(probs)
    div(class = "card",
        h2(paste("Tomorrow is most likely:", states[best])),
        h3(paste0(round(probs[best] * 100, 1), "% probability"))
    )
  })
  
  output$forecast_plot <- renderPlot({
    d <- forecast()
    plot(d$Day, d$High, type = "l", lwd = 3, ylim = c(0, 1), xlab = "Days Ahead", ylab = "Probability")
    lines(d$Day, d$Moderate, lwd = 3, lty = 2)
    lines(d$Day, d$Low, lwd = 3, lty = 3)
    legend("right", legend = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"), lty = c(1, 2, 3), lwd = 3, bty = "n")
    grid()
  })
  
  stationary <- reactive({ stationary_distribution(P()) })
  
  output$stationary_table <- renderTable({
    s <- stationary()
    data.frame(State = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"),
               Probability = round(s, 4),
               Percentage = paste0(round(s * 100, 1), "%"))
  })
  
  output$stationary_plot <- renderPlot({
    s <- stationary()
    barplot(s, names.arg = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"), ylim = c(0, 1),
            ylab = "Long-Run Probability", xlab = "Productivity State")
    grid(nx = NA, ny = NULL)
  })
  
  simulated <- eventReactive(input$run_simulation, {
    d <- data_store()
    states <- c("High", "Moderate", "Low")
    current <- if (nrow(d) == 0) 2 else match(tail(d$State, 1), states)
    result <- character(input$sim_days)
    
    for (i in 1:input$sim_days) {
      result[i] <- states[current]
      current <- sample(1:3, size = 1, prob = P()[current, ])
    }
    return(result)
  })
  
  output$simulation_plot <- renderPlot({
    req(simulated())
    y <- match(simulated(), c("Low", "Moderate", "High"))
    plot(y, type = "s", ylim = c(1, 3), yaxt = "n", xlab = "Future Day", ylab = "Productivity")
    axis(2, at = 1:3, labels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"))
    grid()
  })
  
  output$simulation_table <- renderTable({
    req(simulated())
    counts <- table(factor(simulated(), levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")))
    data.frame(State = names(counts), Days = as.numeric(counts),
               Percentage = paste0(round(counts / length(simulated()) * 100, 1), "%"))
  })
  
  output$total_problems <- renderText({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return("0")
    sum(d$Problems_Attempted, na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  output$overall_accuracy <- renderText({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return("-")
    attempted <- sum(d$Problems_Attempted, na.rm = TRUE)
    correct <- sum(d$Problems_Correct, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (attempted == 0) "-" else paste0(round(correct / attempted * 100, 1), "%")
  })
  
  output$avg_mock_score <- renderText({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return("-")
    scores <- d$Mock_Score[!is.na(d$Mock_Score)]
    if (length(scores) == 0) "-" else paste0(round(mean(scores), 1), "%")
  })
  
  output$total_study_hours <- renderText({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return("0 h")
    paste0(round(sum(d$Study_Hours, na.rm = TRUE), 1), " h")
  })
  
  output$accuracy_plot <- renderPlot({
    d <- data_store()
    d <- d[!is.na(d$Problems_Attempted) & d$Problems_Attempted > 0, ]
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "No problem performance data recorded yet."); return()
    }
    acc <- d$Problems_Correct / d$Problems_Attempted * 100
    plot(d$Date, acc, type = "o", pch = 19, lwd = 2, ylim = c(0, 100), xlab = "Date", ylab = "Accuracy (%)")
    grid()
  })
  
  output$mock_plot <- renderPlot({
    d <- data_store()
    d <- d[!is.na(d$Mock_Score), ]
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "No mock exam scores logged yet."); return()
    }
    plot(d$Date, d$Mock_Score, type = "o", pch = 19, lwd = 2, ylim = c(0, 100), xlab = "Date", ylab = "Mock Score (%)")
    grid()
  })
  
  output$exam_breakdown <- renderTable({
    d <- data_store()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
    agg <- aggregate(cbind(Study_Hours, Problems_Attempted, Problems_Correct) ~ Exam, data = d, FUN = sum, na.rm = TRUE)
    agg$Accuracy <- ifelse(agg$Problems_Attempted > 0,
                           paste0(round(agg$Problems_Correct / agg$Problems_Attempted * 100, 1), "%"), "-")
    
    data.frame(Exam = agg$Exam, Total_Study_Hours = round(agg$Study_Hours, 1),
               Problems_Attempted = agg$Problems_Attempted, Problems_Correct = agg$Problems_Correct, Accuracy = agg$Accuracy)
  })
  
  countdown_data <- reactive({
    d <- data_store()
    if (input$countdown_exam != "All logged exams") { d <- d[d$Exam == input$countdown_exam, ] }
    d
  })
  
  output$countdown_summary <- renderUI({
    d <- countdown_data()
    target_total <- input$exam_length_hours * input$hours_per_exam_hour
    hours_logged <- sum(d$Study_Hours, na.rm = TRUE)
    hours_remaining <- max(target_total - hours_logged, 0)
    days_remaining <- as.numeric(as.Date(input$exam_date) - Sys.Date())
    
    if (days_remaining <= 0) {
      div(class = "danger-box", h3("Your exam date has passed or is today."))
    } else {
      required_pace <- hours_remaining / days_remaining
      recent <- tail(d[order(d$Date), ], 14)
      recent_pace <- if (nrow(recent) > 0) mean(recent$Study_Hours, na.rm = TRUE) else 0
      on_pace <- recent_pace >= required_pace
      box_class <- if (on_pace) "success-box" else "warning-box"
      
      div(class = box_class,
          h3(paste0(days_remaining, " days until your exam")),
          p(paste0("Target: ", round(target_total, 0), " total study hours.")),
          p(paste0("Logged so far: ", round(hours_logged, 1), " h. Remaining: ", round(hours_remaining, 1), " h.")),
          h4(paste0("Required pace: ", round(required_pace, 2), " h/day  |  Recent average: ", round(recent_pace, 2), " h/day"))
      )
    }
  })
  
  output$countdown_progress_bar <- renderUI({
    d <- countdown_data()
    target_total <- input$exam_length_hours * input$hours_per_exam_hour
    hours_logged <- sum(d$Study_Hours, na.rm = TRUE)
    pct <- if (target_total > 0) min(hours_logged / target_total * 100, 100) else 0
    
    div(class = "progress-outer",
        div(class = "progress-inner", style = paste0("width:", round(pct, 1), "%;"), paste0(round(pct, 1), "%"))
    )
  })
  
  output$pace_plot <- renderPlot({
    d <- countdown_data()
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "No logged study sessions found for selected criteria."); return()
    }
    d <- d[order(d$Date), ]
    target_total <- input$exam_length_hours * input$hours_per_exam_hour
    hours_remaining <- max(target_total - sum(d$Study_Hours, na.rm = TRUE), 0)
    days_remaining <- max(as.numeric(as.Date(input$exam_date) - Sys.Date()), 1)
    required_pace <- hours_remaining / days_remaining
    
    barplot(d$Study_Hours, names.arg = format(d$Date, "%d %b"), las = 2, ylab = "Study Hours",
            ylim = c(0, max(c(d$Study_Hours, required_pace)) * 1.2))
    abline(h = required_pace, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$scenario_preset, {
    preset <- scenario_presets[[input$scenario_preset]]
    if (!is.null(preset$extra_study)) {
      updateSliderInput(session, "extra_study", value = preset$extra_study)
      updateSliderInput(session, "less_distraction", value = preset$less_distraction)
      updateSliderInput(session, "extra_sleep", value = preset$extra_sleep)
      updateSliderInput(session, "better_focus", value = preset$better_focus)
    }
  })
  
  output$scenario_preset_desc <- renderUI({ p(style = "color:#374151;", scenario_presets[[input$scenario_preset]]$desc) })
  
  improved_P <- reactive({
    base <- P()
    improvement <- input$extra_study * 0.025 + input$less_distraction * 0.035 + input$extra_sleep * 0.020 + input$better_focus * 0.025
    new_P <- base
    new_P[1, 1] <- base[1, 1] + improvement
    new_P[1, 3] <- base[1, 3] - improvement
    new_P[2, 1] <- base[2, 1] + improvement * 0.8
    new_P[2, 3] <- base[2, 3] - improvement * 0.8
    new_P[3, 2] <- base[3, 2] + improvement * 0.5
    new_P[3, 3] <- base[3, 3] - improvement * 0.5
    new_P[new_P < 0] <- 0
    new_P / rowSums(new_P)
  })
  
  output$scenario_table <- renderTable({
    current <- stationary_distribution(P())
    improved <- stationary_distribution(improved_P())
    data.frame(
      Productivity = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"),
      Current_Routine = paste0(round(current * 100, 1), "%"),
      Better_Routine = paste0(round(improved * 100, 1), "%"),
      Change = paste0(ifelse(improved >= current, "+", ""), round((improved - current) * 100, 1), " pp")
    )
  })
  
  output$scenario_plot <- renderPlot({
    current <- stationary_distribution(P())
    improved <- stationary_distribution(improved_P())
    values <- rbind(current, improved)
    barplot(values, beside = TRUE, names.arg = c("High", "Moderate", "Low"),
            ylim = c(0, max(values) + 0.15), ylab = "Long-Run Probability", xlab = "Productivity State",
            legend.text = c("Current Routine", "Better Routine"), args.legend = list(x = "topright", bty = "n"))
    grid(nx = NA, ny = NULL)
  })
  
  output$scenario_message <- renderUI({
    current <- stationary_distribution(P())
    improved <- stationary_distribution(improved_P())
    change <- (improved[1] - current[1]) * 100
    div(class = "scenario-box",
        h3("\U0001F331 What does this mean?"),
        p(paste0("Under your current routine, long-run High productivity probability is ", round(current[1] * 100, 1), "%.")),
        p(paste0("Under this scenario, that becomes ", round(improved[1] * 100, 1), "%.")),
        h4(paste0("Estimated change: ", ifelse(change >= 0, "+", ""), round(change, 1), " percentage points."))
    )
  })
  
  output$download <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { "actuarial_study_history.csv" },
    content = function(file) { write.csv(data_store(), file, row.names = FALSE) }
  )
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
